intelligence.enrichment: A flat transparent glass pane leaves objects looking the same size and shape; a convex lens can make a nearby object appear erect and enlarged, while lens type and distance change the appearance of the object seen through it. transparent surface shape and object distance determine the apparent size and orientation seen through the material The learner predicts how objects appear through a convex lens, concave lens, or flat transparent glass piece using shape and distance. All transparent materials show objects the same way because light passes through each of them.
